settings.letter:
The water was off. The towel was back on its hook. But the tight, itchy feeling stayed.

Lather started in a hard-water town, with a child's arms red by bedtime and a bathroom shelf full of washes that weren't working for us.

Mara Ellis began with the labels. Fragrance, dyes, harsh foaming agents: one by one, things came off the list. Oat, shea, glycerin and gentle sugar cleansers stayed.

That question still guides the line today: what does this product need to do, and what can we leave out?
settings.image_alt: A warm stone bathroom with a freestanding bath, towels and a leafy plant
settings.caption: A quieter approach to everyday body care.

settings.text: A body wash doesn't need a perfume to do its job. We keep fragrance out of most of our line, so there's one less thing to think about.

settings.title: The everyday choice
settings.text: Calm, Soft and Rich washes have no added fragrance. So do our lotions, cream, milk and Oat bar. Choose by how your skin feels and the texture you prefer.

settings.title: One scented exception
settings.text: Chamomile wash contains 0.2% chamomile flower oil. It's our only scented product. Its ingredient information names the oil and allergen, so you can make the choice for yourself.

settings.title: Your skin gets the last word
settings.text: Fragrance-free doesn't mean every ingredient will suit every person. Read the list and try a small patch first. If something doesn't agree with your skin, stop using it.
We build around the wash, the rinse and the feeling after. The ingredient list should help you understand all three.
settings.image_alt: Calm wash with soft foam on wet travertine, steam rising behind it
settings.note: No cure promises. Just body care with its purpose written plainly.

settings.title: Start with the task
settings.text: Gentle sugar cleansers help lift away the day. Glycerin, oat and oils give each wash its own feel. We choose the texture to match the job.

settings.title: Keep the differences clear
settings.text: A soft everyday wash, a thicker wash for very dry skin, a light lotion or a rich cream. We explain what changes, rather than giving everything the same promise.

settings.title: Put the list where you need it
settings.text: Ingredients live alongside each product. You can read them before you buy, compare the textures and choose how much care your skin needs.
Nine products. Choose a wash, then the texture that feels right after it.
settings.footer_text: One product is a perfectly good place to begin. Find what suits your skin, and leave the rest.
